S1-01.notes: Dev pool, Google provider, SPA and dev test client are deployed and resource checks pass in 248fa024-49a0-4ebc-bc76-73a236ca9aaa. Real owner Google consent/callback was attempted but rejected before invitation lookup: Cognito lowercases the Google username prefix in this case-insensitive pool. Backend #28 prepares the verified regression fix. First/repeat federation acceptance remains pending; prod stays disabled.

S1-02.notes: Owner accepted ADR-0008–0011 on 2026-10-11; decisions are merged in all three repositories. Live binding and latency proof are separate S1-18 acceptance work.

S1-03.notes: Warmed live alias and pool-scoped attachment are deployed; real owner sign-in exposed the uppercase-only Google prefix guard. Paired synthetic pending-supervisor events prove Google_ allows and google_ denies on version 3. Backend #28 compares only the provider prefix without case sensitivity, preserving username, verified email, invitation checks and response flags. Actual Google acceptance awaits its release.

S1-04.notes: Identity migration and sqlc lookups are merged and applied on dev; PostgreSQL lifecycle, uniqueness and idempotency tests pass.

S1-17.notes: presignup_ro bootstrap and exact SELECT grants on users/invitations are merged and deployed. Negative privilege tests cover writes and unrelated future tables; the deployed trigger uses its scoped IAM connection.

S1-19.notes: Frontend /me spec, generated types and test handler are merged and released with backend S1-05. The API drift gate and frontend tests pass; real endpoint/auth UI work remains S1-08/S1-10.

S1-09.notes: Database seed/admin invitation and three native dev fixtures are deployed. Native profiles and uninvited denial pass against real Gateway; recovery support/sole-admin decision are merged. Database repeat idempotency is verified; a subsequent enabled release must confirm native repeat counts remain zero. First real admin binding awaits the Google prefix repair.

S1-06.notes: Backend identity/binding is merged and released. Real native tokens resolve invited profiles and deny uninvited accounts; transactional and privacy/race tests pass. Real Google first/repeat binding remains pending the trigger prefix repair in backend #28.

Admin grants no supervision override. /me demonstrates the handler policy call; later slices implement relationship storage.

S1-08.notes: Backend profile endpoint is merged/released and passes actual native-token 200/403 with the explicit DTO and no-store behavior. The invited name renders in the deployed UI and uninvited users see access denied. Real Google owner profile acceptance awaits backend #28.

Role-authority runbook documents next-request enforcement, in-flight request timing and S5-05 Cognito follow-up. The runbook gives exact additional-admin invocation and safe failure handling. Owner explicitly elected to retain the sole dev admin; no second live identity or live recovery drill is claimed.

S1-13.notes: Frontend #22 prepares the release native-browser cases and passes all CI checks. Both native cases ran successfully against enabled dev: real Gateway/backend invited 200 and uninvited 403 relayed unchanged into deployed UI, native revocation, safe storage and no token-group role elevation. Google protocol/hosted logout are intercepted; no auth bypass is shipped. Release automation after merge and recorded real Google first/repeat sign-in/logout remain pending the prefix repair.

S1-18.notes: Live owner Google attempt exposed the case-insensitive provider-prefix bug, reproduced with a still-pending fictional supervisor invitation. Native/resource acceptance passes. 100 direct synthetic alias invocations produced expected admission outcomes; excluding one initialization-containing log tail leaves 99 warm samples with REPORT p50 3.03 ms, p95 43.17 ms and p99/max 54.37 ms. This is not actual federation or cold p99 proof; real first/repeat binding and representative cold measurements remain pending.
